setBoundary: State mentioned as an example requiring baseline groundwater monitoring around fracking wells (before drilling and for a period after) in the Marcellus Shale discussion.

items.why: Directly states an example state: Pennsylvania requires fracking companies to monitor groundwater quality at nearby wells before drilling and for a certain period after drilling is complete.
Reinforces the Pennsylvania baseline testing/accountability point (pre-drilling water quality test reports), which is consistent with the monitoring requirement referenced in the follow-up question.
